Messages.Author: FC
Messages.Body:
Can you:

1) Play vote modifiers like Bewitching Oration even if
the vote is intercepted?

2) Elect to use sup. Cats' Guidiance if the intercepting
Minion has a Sport Bike and only needs +1 intercept?

Thanks
FC

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
FC wrote:
> Can you:
> 1) Play vote modifiers like Bewitching Oration even if
> the vote is intercepted?

No. Cards like Bewitching Oration are only usable during the
referendum part of the political action.

> 2) Elect to use sup. Cats' Guidiance if the intercepting
> Minion has a Sport Bike and only needs +1 intercept?

No. You cannot add intercept unless you need intercept.

Messages.Body:

>> 2) Elect to use sup. Cats' Guidiance if the intercepting
>> Minion has a Sport Bike and only needs +1 intercept?
>
>No. You cannot add intercept unless you need intercept.

If I might add a slight clarification, I believe the confusion arose
from whether or not you had to take the intercept from Sport Bike or
not, which of course you do since it simply awards +1 intercept to the
minion it is on, not an "optional" or "may" clause.

This may help make things a little clearer for the question asker.
